summary: Full end-to-end verification of the SKINNY JAB and PUB PINT rare pickups via the temporary window.__DP_DEV force-spawn hooks across all three DRUNKNESS levels (SOBER 0.0, TIPSY 0.5, ABSOLUTELY PIGEONED ~1.0). All critical assertions PASS: Skinny Jab resets currentFatness to 0 without touching totalChips or score, jabActive returns to 0, POP element renders, and setFat(1) correctly restarts fattening. Pub Pint is confirmed VISUAL-ONLY: boost=1, pintActive=0, currentFatness unchanged, totalChips unchanged (NO +5), pigeon alive. Boost duration measured at 4.29s (spec: CONFIG.PINT_BOOST_MS=4200 -> ~4.2s). Order independence verified in BOTH directions (pint-before-jab and jab-then-pint) in the same run without interference. Drunkness slider drag verified for ABSOLUTELY PIGEONED (drunkLevel~=0.99). Space-flap controls remain functional throughout.
action_items: REMOVE the temporary dev hooks before release: /app/frontend/src/screens/GameScreen.js line 22 `const DEV_FORCE_SPAWN = true;` -> set false or delete the entire useEffect that exposes window.__DP_DEV. Also remove engine.devForceSkinnyJab / devForcePint / devSetFat exports from /app/frontend/src/game/engine.js if no longer needed.
critical_code_review_comments: engine.js devForceSkinnyJab bumps fatChips to SKINNY_JAB_MIN_FAT+15 if too lean before placing the jab. This is dev-only and correctly gated by !running/dead. Safe to remove.
GameScreen.js exposes window.__DP_DEV in a useEffect that cleans up on unmount — good hygiene for the temporary hook.
Pint boost gate in getSnapshot uses pintT>0 && now<pintT+PINT_BOOST_MS which correctly falls to 0 after ~4.2s (measured 4.29s in test).
Skinny Jab collection correctly sets fatChips=0 only; chipCount/score are untouched (verified totalChips before/after == identical).
Pub Pint collection correctly sets only pintT=now; no chip/score/fat mutation (verified all fields identical before/after).

success_rate.frontend: 100% on all specified pickup assertions (jab reset, chips-untouched, POP element, pint boost=1, pint chips/fat-untouched, ~4.2s duration, order independence both directions, alive after force-spawns, drunkLevel slider changes state correctly)

The drunkness slider requires a proper mouse.down/move/up drag gesture to move the thumb (single mouse.click sometimes doesn't trigger PanResponder). Measured PINT_BOOST_MS in real gameplay = 4.29s (spec 4200ms).
